title: E0084: SQL query string concatenation
plain_english: Concatenating user input directly into SQL query strings can allow attackers to inject arbitrary SQL and read, modify, or delete database data.
why_matters: SQL injection is a serious vulnerability. It can lead to: - Theft of user data (such as emails, passwords, or payment information) - Authentication bypass - Database modification or deletion - Broader server compromise in some environments
what_it_checks: Cases where user input (`$_GET`, `$_POST`, `$_REQUEST`, `$_COOKIE`, etc.) is concatenated directly into the SQL string
